Multi-line text fields in desk-look panes and the question card now have a Clear button that empties the field in one press.

- Ctrl+U in these fields only deletes the current line (a second press deletes the line break), so emptying pasted text took two presses per line
- Clear sits after the field in the Asana comment and comment-edit fields, the Slack reply field, the diff line comment field and the question card's text answer; the cursor stays in the emptied field
- Clearing an Asana comment also drops the mentions picked for it; clearing a diff line comment keeps the chosen line range
- One-line fields (session search, diff filter, Asana search, people search) are unchanged: Ctrl+U already empties them

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
